# CC Plugin Forge: scaffold and manage Claude Code plugins

Curated by Skill Harbor — @softaworks's CC Plugin Forge: build and manage Claude Code plugins with correct structure, manifests and marketplace integration. Create a new plugin with create_plugin.py (scaffolds the directory structure, generates the plugin.json manifest, a README template, and registers it in marketplace.json); add components (commands with subdirectory-based namespace:command naming, skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers); bump versions in both manifests with bump_version.py (semantic versioning); test locally (/plugin marketplace add, install, uninstall, reinstall); and publish. Includes framework/utility/domain plugin patterns, a manual structure fallback, a version-management checklist, conventional-commit guidance, and bundled reference docs (plugin-structure.md, marketplace-schema.md, workflows.md). Honest caveats: the skill ships its own automation scripts (create_plugin.py, bump_version.py) — review them before running; covers plugin manifests and mechanics, not marketplace approval or distribution processes. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
